title: i18n: let a dependent package's fieldPatches label/description be translated from that package's own catalog (split from #33800 half 2)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Maintainer-directed (filing gate ③): the maintainer chose 「先修新增，另开卡」 on #33800 half 2 (2026-11-15). Today (D) a dependent package's `fieldPatches` label/description shows as written in every language: the merged catalog key `objects.<obj>.fields.<f>.label` lost the package id, and #29624 deliberately ended "whichever merges last wins".

## Design question this card answers first

Where a patching package's own catalog row sits in the precedence of ruling 6631250894 (the three-level order, `i18n-resolver.ts:432-461`) and how serving reaches it (likely a new option carrying the patching package's rows, a new exported parameter). Because it adds a precedence level and an export, the route goes back to the maintainer as a decision before any dev.

## Notes

- description was never translated, even in 18.2.0; label changed with #29624. Not a regression.
- Same patched text reads Chinese on the detail page (`/i18n/translations`) and source text on the create form today; the card's design must close that gap.
- Order: after #33800 half 1 lands (same resolver area).
- Prior rulings read: ADR-0029 D9.2a (:513); ADR-0146 D2, D10 (:596-606); ruling 6631250894; #29624; #33800 seat ruling.
